source.name: amCharts geodata, India point of view
source.licence: Free amCharts licence. Attribution must stay visible and the LICENSE file must travel with the data. Both are in this repository.
source.note: India is drawn as the Government of India depicts it, including Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Aksai Chin. Several of these boundaries are disputed internationally and other governments publish different depictions. This project does not draw or adjust any boundary itself. It selects a published dataset and names it.
source.stateData: State and union territory boundaries are the 2023 set.
